description.value: A Boston Bar First Nation campground in the Fraser Canyon, set between the Fraser River and Anderson Creek with mountain and water views, full facilities including flush toilets and showers, and a Nlaka'pamux Heritage Village on-site; riverside and creekside sites are closed through late May due to spring runoff, and the season runs April to October.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is comprehensive and directly confirms amenities listed on the facility page: showers, flush toilets, WiFi, water, sani-station, 30 AMP electrical sites, and firepits at every site. OSM tags align closely with the website on tents, caravans, toilets, sani-dump, and fee=yes. The site is Indigenous-owned (Boston Bar First Nation), includes an on-site Gas & Store and restaurant, and features an online booking system, all corroborated by the website text.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; website shows primary number 604.860.9286 (used here) plus alternate numbers 604-378-1279 (cancellations/changes) and 604-867-9089 (late-arrival calls).
OSM record contains no street address; only 'Tuckkwiowhum, Boston Bar, BC' is derivable from the website header.
Community tag 'Unknown / Okanagan & Thompson' appears geographically incorrect — the campground is in the Fraser Canyon near Boston Bar, not in the Okanagan & Thompson region.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, actively operated campground with tenting sites, showers, water, and online reservations situated along the Fraser Canyon — a key cycling corridor — making it a practical and culturally distinctive stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Campground is owned and operated by Boston Bar First Nation. Website text ('We're excited to host you when the 2026 season begins') confirms active operation for the current season.

wow_evidence: Boston Bar First Nation campground...showers, flush toilets, WiFi, water...Nlaka'pamux Heritage Village on-site
